 Versus

 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Harshvardhan Shivsundaram, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Mohammed Arif, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma
 Oral Order
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 by both modes i.e. speed post as well as ordinary post with A/D, for which necessary requisites must be filed on or before 24.11.2023, failing which the quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 29.02.2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 18.02.2019 passed by the learned C.J.M., Nawada in Complaint Case No.1187/2016, whereby cognizance of offences under sections 406, 420 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code has been taken, shall remain stayed.

The learned counsel submits that the petitioner at the relevant time Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.68073 of 2019(2) dt.06-11-2023 when the occurrence is alleged to have taken place was posted as Special Land Acquisition Officer, Patna Flood Protection Project, Patna, it is next submitted that from bare perusal of the allegation as alleged in the F.I.R., it would manifest that the complainant alleges that his ancestral house is situated over a plot of land appertaining to Khata No.66, Plot No.891, Thana No.151 which was acquired for Fulwaria Reservoir Project, the award was declared in the year 1983-84 and Vikash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 6 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52963938/
1 compensation amount was received by him/his ancestor under protest, thereafter a reference application was filed in the land acquisition office in time under the Land Acquisition Act but the same was not forwarded to the concerned Court despite repeated requests, thereafter one Ram Prakash Chaudhary, who was posted as Amin in Rehabilitation Office, Hardia demanded bribe of Rs. 25,000/- from the complainant and other displaced persons for getting forwarded their reference application to the concerned Court, thereafter some money was paid to said Ram Prakash Chaudhary and the reference application was forwarded to the concerned Court in the year 2014, it is further alleged that Ram Prakash Chaudhary further demanded Rs. One lack each from the complainant and other displaced persons on the pretext that if they do not pay the bribe amount which is to be given to the petitioner, false criminal cases would be lodged, when the demand was not fulfilled,

sentences.text: the petitioner Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.68073 of 2019(2) dt.06-11-2023 instituted Nawada (Town) P.S. Case No. 586/2016.
5.

The learned counsel next submits that from bare perusal of the allegation as alleged in the F.I.R.,
it would manifest that even presuming what has been alleged is true without admitting, in that event, the bribe was not demanded by the petitioner rather it was being demanded by one Ram Prakash Chaudhary, further the complainant also alleges that some amount was paid to Ram Prakash Chaudhary, thereafter, the reference application was forwarded to the Court of competent jurisdiction, it is next submitted that if what has been alleged is true then demanding bribe and giving bribe both is an offence and the O.P. No.2 accepts that on demand, he paid bribe amount based on which the reference application was forwarded to the Court of competent jurisdiction, it is next submitted that the petitioner on coming to know that reference application was barred by limitation and the reference was made based on forged and fabricated signature of the authority,
instituted the instant F.I.R. and thus in order to coerce the petitioner into submission, the present false case came to be instituted.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) amit/-
